rules.basis: Every requirement/rule table has a Basis column whose values are Confirmed, Assumption, Open Question or Recommendation.
rules.evidence: Cites at least one source location (path/file.ext:line) or has registry sources.
rules.mermaid: Contains at least one ```mermaid diagram (a specific diagram kind when given, e.g. mermaid:erDiagram).
rules.adr-status: The Status section states Proposed, Accepted, Deprecated or Superseded.
rules.no-secrets: Applies to every document: no credentials, keys, tokens or connection strings with passwords.
